scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with finite numerical diagnostics; no external mathematical audit, publication, or independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem establishes fixed-order thin-shell limits and facet-weight recovery, not convergence rates, finite-thickness formulas, facet directions, a complete cone-volume measure, or full body reconstruction. Historical priority may require a wider literature audit.
title: Thin-shell convexity moments recover facet cone volumes
